scope: effective joint kinetic calibration, not identification of individual E66 electrode parameters
development: three quality-filtered 25C HPPC pulses already exposed; previous C20/C3 OCP fit fixed
evaluation: six GITT segments and 0.5C/1C curves previously exposed; separate-session transfer, explicitly nonblind
protected: no module validation/blind numeric payload, no historical reserved episodes
fixed: previous OCP corrections, contact R, Q=61.259778569358865 Ah, Chen2020 diffusivity and geometry
fit: minimize equal-pulse mean squared loaded relative-voltage residual; bounded scalar search in log multiplier; mesh40; max20 iterations xatol0.01; deterministic
profiles: fixed multipliers 0.5,1,1.5,2,3,4,6,8; report per-pulse optima from profile and leave-one-pulse-out grid optima; not confidence intervals
freeze: write code/protocol/fit/source hashes and versions before any new predictive evaluation; reject drift
numerics: mesh40, rtol1e-7 atol1e-8; mesh80 SPMe for median HPPC and first GITT; each solve at most90s
GITT: constant median measured discharge followed by 300s rest, initial SOC coulomb proxy and isothermal initial measured T; relative baseline anchored; no diffusion coefficient fit
uncertainty: no iid confidence intervals or inference to independent cells; scalar profile conditional on fixed nuisance parameters
failure_policy: record errors/timeouts and failed gates without retuning; nonconvergence not numerical PASS
thermal: temperature prediction not implemented; no thermal validation claim
approval: results may FAIL or remain INCONCLUSIVE; no stage5 authorization
